quote: Upon approaching an authorized emergency vehicle or an official vehicle of a regulatory agency which is moving or preparing to move in any direction, including, without limitation, arriving at or leaving the scene of a crash or other incident, and making use of flashing lights meeting the requirements of subsection 3 of NRS 484A.480 [DEF-NRS-484A-480-3], the driver of any other vehicle shall, except when otherwise directed by a law enforcement officer: Be prepared to stop. As used in this section, “preparing to move” means any indication that is visible to an approaching driver that an authorized emergency vehicle or an official vehicle of a regulatory agency is about to move, including, without limitation: (a) A movement of the vehicle; or (b) The use of hand signals by the driver of the vehicle.

activation.condition: Approach to a qualifying moving or visibly preparing emergency or regulatory vehicle using qualifying flashing lights.

obligation.description: Be prepared to stop throughout the approach.

exceptions.source_clause: except when otherwise directed by a law enforcement officer
exceptions.description: An original officer direction may alter the response.

timing.description: Observe preparedness continuously during approach without a legal numeric threshold.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: authorized emergency vehicle or an official vehicle of a regulatory agency
judgment_calls_needed.note: Blueprint identity does not prove authorization or agency role.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: moving or preparing to move in any direction
judgment_calls_needed.note: Original motion or driver-visible indication must be reviewed; no numeric speed defines preparation.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: flashing lights meeting the requirements of subsection 3 of NRS 484A.480
judgment_calls_needed.note: Native lamp readback and original pixels require independent equipment review.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: except when otherwise directed by a law enforcement officer
judgment_calls_needed.note: Officer identity, direction, recipient and timing need original sources.
Brake response and stopping distance are engineering observations, not a legal readiness threshold.
Original camera evidence and actor geometry must establish sight line.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: use of hand signals by the driver of the vehicle
judgment_calls_needed.note: A separate source-driver hand signal and its visibility remain to be constructed and reviewed.
